item.title: How to find meaningful work
item.description: This guide will help you find a project, a job, or a career that fits your needs. But it’s not just about landing a better job. It’s about finding what is meaningful to you and then making a living around it. There are 10 exercises divided into 4 days that will take you from understanding what you want to a new work-life design you can put into action immediately.
